newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Everbright firms up after Telecom deal.
newsitem.headline: Everbright firms up after Telecom deal.

text.p: Shares of companies in the China Everbright group rose on Monday after the announcement on Friday their parent China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd would buy into Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd, brokers said.
"Anticipation that the parent may inject the HK Telecom stake into one of its listed units fuelled buying," said a dealing director at a European brokerage.
"In view of the core business, China Everbright Technology is seen to be the appropriate one to receive the injection," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Shares of China Everbright Technology Ltd were up HK$0.71 to HK$1.96 just before the midday break.
China Everbright International Ltd rose HK$0.205 to HK$2.075 and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd gained HK$0.65 to HK$9.45.
On Friday, CITIC Pacific Ltd announced it would sell its 7.74 percent stake in Hongkong Telecom to China-controlled China Everbright Holdings for HK$11.4 billion.
Anticipation the group may continue its asset expansion also fuelled hopes of a strong asset base in future, which underpinned demand, brokers said.
Hongkong Telecom shares were up HK$0.75 to HK$15.25.
